blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A 44-year-old man tagged as the eighth most wanted person in Eastern Visayas was arrested in Valenzuela City on Tuesday for alleged sexual offenses involving a child, police said. The suspect, a resident of Biri, Northern Samar, was arrested along Tatalon Street in Barangay Ugong in a joint operation involving police units from Eastern Visayas and the National Capital Region. Biri Municipal Police Station personnel, in coordination with the Regional Intelligence Division of the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO), Northern Samar Police Intelligence Unit, and Regional Special Operations Unit 8, conducted the operation.
